bullets.text: duck carried a line about cubes and circles through the graves at okunoin. the old stones there are mostly a cube wearing a ball.
the microwave beeps three times to say it's done, then once more later, in case i forgot. i did.
relabeling the rice bin. it has said 'flour' since two moves ago and the rice never once objected.
quiet in the good way. like a room right after the washing machine stops.
